newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-NORWAY NAMES WORLD CUP SQUAD VS FINLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWAY NAMES WORLD CUP SQUAD VS FINLAND.

text.p: Injured Manchester United attacker Ole Gunnar Solskjaer will miss Norway's World Cup qualifier against Finland on August 20.
Solskjaer was on suspension and missed the last World Cup qualifier against Hungary in June, which Norway drew 1-1.
The remainder of the squad is largely unchanged from the previous line-up and includes forwards Erik Mykland and Frank Strandi, who both recently joined Panathinaikos in Greece.
Norway's coach Egil "Drillo" Olsen also hopes to have Blackburn defender Henning Berg and Liverpool midfielder Oyvind Leonhardsen, who have both been injured.
Norway top World Cup qualifying group three, which also includes Finland, Hungary, Switzerland and Azerbaijan, having won three and drawn two of their five matches.
Defence: Henning Berg (Blackburn), Stig Inge Bjornebye (Liverpool), Dan Eggen (Brondby), Gunnar Halle (Leeds), Alf-Inge Haland (Leeds), Ronny Johnsen (Manchester United), Bent Skammelsrud (Rosenborg)

Midfield/attack: Jostein Flo (Stromsgodset), Tore Andre Flo (Chelsea), Oyvind Leonhardsen (Liverpool), Erik Mykland (Panathinaikos), Kjetil Rekdal (Hertha Berlin), Petter Rudi (Molde), Stale Solbakken (Lillestrom), Frank Strandli (Panathinaikos), Egil Ostenstad (Southampton).
